# Neg Foxtrot invented mechanism

Radoslav Radev advises that if you train four times per week, only one, maximum two, workouts go to failure. [src: vid-KCRETdZ0l78 @ 01:50]

## Details

- If you train four times per week: only one, maximum two, to go to failure. [src: vid-KCRETdZ0l78 @ 01:50]
- Five times per week: two times going to failure. [src: vid-KCRETdZ0l78 @ 01:50]
- In the other workouts, focus on the technique; you can use a resistance band. [src: vid-KCRETdZ0l78 @ 02:01]

- Failure training depletes calcium in the motor neurons, which takes 72 hours to restore. [src: vid-KCRETdZ0l78 @ 01:50]

## Evidence

- vid-KCRETdZ0l78 @ 01:50 (Radoslav Radev): "And my advice for you is if you train four times per week only one maximum two to go to a failure. Five times per week, two times going to failure."
- vid-KCRETdZ0l78 @ 02:01 (Radoslav Radev): "what to do in the other workouts? Focus on the technique. You can use resistance band"
- vid-KCRETdZ0l78 @ 01:35 (Radoslav Radev): "Natural athlete who are not taking steroids or something like this to make your nervous system ready and recovered for your next workout you need a couple of days."

## Why This Matters

He says a natural athlete needs a couple of days to make the nervous system ready and recovered for the next workout. [src: vid-KCRETdZ0l78 @ 01:35]
